data.one_liner: Print receipts via Bluetooth to Android thermal printers
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets Flutter apps send ESC/POS commands to Bluetooth thermal printers. It supports 58mm and 80mm paper sizes and works only on Android.
use_when: Printing receipts in POS or small business apps
Need a simple API for thermal printers
Android-only projects that require Bluetooth printing
weaknesses: No built-in image support (requires separate image package)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec. No special permissions needed beyond Bluetooth. No build_runner or codegen.
